method: Editorial reading questions and intended readers authored per guide. Ten missing outcome accounts received additional indexed primary-text checks, with separate provenance and date; the aluminum-foam quantitative fire result remains unresolved. Three paragraphs allocate identified source-note facts to scope, methods and findings/interpretation. Missing outcome inventories remain explicitly labeled; no numerical inference from titles. Definitions and explicit reproduction gaps provide paragraph context; an editorial interpretation check is labeled separately from reported findings. Takeaways and holds reuse original reviewed editorial notes. This is not a new full-paper, human or domain review.
rights: Original editorial summaries; no raw papers, abstracts, complete source tables or figures retained.
